body.name: Finite recovery
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Alg}_E\) queries all \(a,b\in V\) and \(C\subseteq V\setminus\{a\}\), enumerates the finite class \(\mathfrak D(V)\) with candidate set \(U_{\to}\cup U_{\leftrightarrow}\), unions both edge types over all matching DMGs, and marks any directed edge, bidirected edge, directed loop, or bidirected loop compelled exactly when deleting it changes the signature.
